# Masakali Indian Cuisine

> Masakali Indian Cuisine operates two Ottawa restaurants in Stittsville and Wellington. Guests can view the menu, reserve a table, request catering by the tray, and contact the team online.

## Contact
- Masakali Indian Cuisine – Stittsville: 5507 Hazeldean Rd Unit C3-1, Stittsville, ON K2S 0P5, CA; Phone +1-613-878-3939
- Masakali Indian Cuisine – Wellington: 1111 Wellington St. W, Ottawa, ON K1Y 1P1, CA; Phone +1-613-792-9777
- Email: masakaliottawa@gmail.com
- Website: https://masakaliottawa.ca
